entities.name: Threonyl-tRNA synthetase
observations: The 640-residue query sequence exactly matches curated Halobacterium salinarum threonine--tRNA ligase B0R6G6 at 100% identity and full coverage.
Pfam domains support threonyl-tRNA synthetase architecture: TGS, tRNA_SAD, tRNA-synt_2b catalytic, and HGTP_anticodon domains.
Curated annotation assigns EC 6.1.1.3 and a homodimeric cytoplasmic enzyme.
Curated annotation states that one Zn2+ ion is bound per subunit.

entities.name: Threonyl-tRNA aminoacylation
observations: Overall reaction: tRNA(Thr) + L-threonine + ATP → L-threonyl-tRNA(Thr) + AMP + diphosphate + H+.
The mechanism proceeds through L-threonyl-AMP formation followed by transfer of threonine to the tRNA acceptor end.
Reaction is mapped to Rhea:24624 and enzyme classification EC 6.1.1.3.

entities.name: Zinc ion
observations: Curated threonyl-tRNA synthetase annotation reports binding of one Zn2+ ion per subunit; the sequence analysis does not independently establish metal occupancy or catalytic necessity.
